records.description: Compress & resize images in your browser — free, private, and offline. Supports batch processing and common formats (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, etc.). No uploads, no limits, just fast results.

records.name: Anonpolls.com
records.tagline: Anonymous Polls for everyone!
records.description: Anonymity: Share your opinions freely without fear of being identified. No Accounts Required: Create and participate in polls instantly without the hassle of signing up. Simple n Fast: Easy create a new poll, share the link, and view the results in real-time.

records.name: Talent Cure
records.tagline: Hire verified healthcare professionals using AI
records.description: Hire healthcare professionals in the U.S. 70% faster with TalentCure’s AI recruiting platform. We help healthcare companies directly source nurses, physicians; allied health think LinkedIn, but built exclusively for healthcare.

records.name: LegalWyze
records.tagline: Legal billing software with timesheet tracking
records.description: LegalWyze is a secure and scalable legal billing software that automates billing, tracks time, and helps law firms manage payments efficiently.

records.name: Trip Roulette
records.tagline: Discover your next adventure
records.description: Trip Roulette is your personal antidote to travel indecision. Spin the globe to discover your next adventure, complete with an AI-generated travel guide and a custom-created image to spark your imagination.

records.name: Lace
records.tagline: Transform your email inbox into a creative workspace.
records.description: Built right into your inbox, Lace’s Chrome Extension transforms your Gmail into a creative workspace, organizing design assets and generating task lists from messy email threads to help you stay in flow.

records.name: Context Hunt
records.tagline: Feed ALL your tabs & YouTube transcripts to AI, in one click
records.description: When I needed AI to have extra context, I would open 20+ tabs. For YouTube Videos, Click "View More," drag & copy all the transcripts, repeat 20 times. Open another tab, repeat again!! 🤬 So I built this extension, all i goatta do is press "Copy all"

records.name: Moonstone AI
records.tagline: AI Diary Assistant
records.description: Write freely, and AI will automatically organize your tasks and build a clear history of the people in your life. From daily notes to lifelong memories, everything stays private, on your device and iCloud.

records.name: CashDuezy
records.tagline: Subscription manager
records.description: Track, manage, and cancel your subscriptions with CashDuezy. Stay on top of renewals, avoid overspending, and simplify your financial life.

records.name: Vectorizer AI - A Figma Plugin
records.tagline: Convert image to perfect SVG vectors with AI,right in Figma
records.description: Transform JPG/PNG to crisp SVG vectors instantly in Figma. AI-powered conversion delivers professional results with one-click simplicity. No external tools needed - perfect for logos, illustrations & design systems. 🎨✨

records.name: ElementorKit
records.tagline: Premium template kits & stock photos for wordpress
records.description: ElementorKit gives you premium template kits & 12M+ stock photos inside WordPress. Build stunning websites faster with Elementor.

records.name: Uvaay
records.tagline: AI Powered Hiring Solution for Future of Talent Acquisition
records.description: Uvaay is an AI-powered recruitment platform that helps recruiters and businesses hire smarter and faster. With tools like JD Creator, Resume Analyzer, ATS integration, and Resume Bank, Uvaay streamlines sourcing, screening, and hiring into one intelligent hub.

records.name: Testronaut
records.tagline: Testronaut – AI-powered mission-based browser testing
records.description: Mission-based autonomous testing powered by AI + Playwright. Write tests in plain English, run real browsers, ship with confidence.

records.name: Link Checker
records.tagline: Find broken links on-demand on your website
records.description: Hi all, I run an affiliate site with hundreds of outbound links. Over time, these links break — products go out of stock, vendors change URLs, and sometimes media just disappears. I got tired of manually checking, so I built check-my-links.com.

records.name: YouTube Studio One-Click Liker
records.tagline: Likes all un-hearted comments on YouTube Studio comment page
records.description: A simple but powerful Chrome extension that saves you time by liking all un-hearted comments on your YouTube Studio comments page with a single click. Likes all un-hearted comments on YouTube Studio page with a single click on the extension icon.

records.name: SpendFlow
records.tagline: Control your bills in a timeline so you never miss a payment
records.description: It's a minimalist web app that solves one simple problem: it gives you a clear, chronological view of all your bills so you never miss a payment and have peace of mind.
